hooks.command:
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */lua/*.lua) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; root="${f%%/lua/*}"; command -v lua-language-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; out=$(lua-language-server --check "$root/lua" --checklevel=Warning --configpath="$root/.luarc.json" --logpath="/tmp/lua-ls-hook-$(basename "$root")" 2>&1 | tr '' '
' | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*$|^Initializing|^[[:space:]]*>+=*[[:space:]]*[0-9]+/[0-9]+'); case "$out" in *'no problems found'*) exit 0 ;; esac; printf 'lua-language-server --check found problems:
%s
' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
